Start: ai-proxy [--restart] [--key=value | --key value ...]
  --restart  Gracefully replace the owned proxy instance, waiting for its exit.
  --version  Print the product version.
Stop:   ai-proxy stop [--data-directory <path>]
Status: ai-proxy status [--data-directory <path>] [-f text|json]  (exit 3 when nothing runs)
USAGE:
    ai-proxy [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    ai-proxy harness claude --model opus

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    gain                    Show estimated initial-request token reductions and 
                            history                                             
    doctor                  Check the setup without changing anything           
    status                  Show the running proxy instance (exit 3 when none   
                            runs)                                               
    stop                    Gracefully stop the running proxy instance          
    shortcut                Create or remove the aph shortcut for ai-proxy      
                            harness                                             
    mcp                     Run the retrieval MCP server over stdio             
    harness <EXECUTABLE>    Launch a harness executable through the running     
                            proxy

DESCRIPTION:
Show estimated initial-request token reductions and history

USAGE:
    ai-proxy gain [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                                 DEFAULT                                        
    -h, --help                                             Prints help          
                                                           information          
    -p, --project                                          Filter to the current
                                                           project directory    
    -f, --format <FORMAT>        text                      Output format: text, 
                                                           json, csv            
        --endpoint <URL>         http://127.0.0.1:17432    Base URL of the      
                                                           running proxy        
    -g, --graph                                            Show an ASCII graph  
                                                           of daily estimated   
                                                           savings              
    -H, --history                                          Show recent provider 
                                                           request history      
    -d, --daily                                            Show daily totals    
                                                           (UTC)                
    -w, --weekly                                           Show Monday-start    
                                                           weekly totals (UTC)  
    -m, --monthly                                          Show monthly totals  
                                                           (UTC)                
    -a, --all                                              Show daily, weekly   
                                                           and monthly totals   
    -F, --failures                                         Show recorded proxy  
                                                           failure
